enGuide: This route's guide begins via the Gekan 'Ooka Report' (大岡レポート) shortcut, reached by choosing New Game from a fresh Gekan (下巻) start. This is used because the companion Joukan (上巻) guide (route_joukan.json) already spends its own Continue on the 瑠璃亜編 branch, so 闇の王編 is reached independently here. xneo.jp's Gekan page does not document the Ooka Report mechanic at all (it assumes the player already continued from a specific Joukan ending), so jpGuide1 is empty for this step group. This shortest path keeps starting BLOOD level at 0.
